systems.name: Motorised
systems.blurb: Curtains that open at the touch of a button or on a schedule. A driven track with a motor sized to the run, for homes, offices and hotels.

systems.name: #20 with rubber
systems.blurb: The #20 profile with a rubber insert, for quieter gliding on a heavier curtain.
The workhorse aluminium track. The widest parts range we stock, in single and double, wall and ceiling.
A heavier profile for wide spans and heavy lined curtains, with a ripple option.

systems.name: #15 bendable
systems.blurb: A bendable track that follows a bay window or a curved wall.

systems.name: #17 groove rubber
systems.blurb: A bendable rubber groove track, for curves that need a quiet, soft glide.

systems.name: KS
systems.blurb: A compact ceiling-fixed system for a discreet, recessed look.

systems.name: Double rail
systems.blurb: One track carrying both a sheer and a main curtain.

systems.name: Roman blind
systems.blurb: The corded track a roman blind is built on.

components.name: Belts
components.purpose: The loop that transmits drive along a motorised track.

components.name: Brackets
components.purpose: Fixes the track to the wall or ceiling. One per metre, never fewer than two.

components.name: Corner joints
components.purpose: Turns the track around a corner or a bay.

components.name: Curtain buckles
components.purpose: Holds the curtain back when it is open.

components.name: Curtain hooks
components.purpose: Joins the curtain tape to the runners.

components.name: Curtain tapes
components.purpose: Sewn to the curtain header to form the pleat.

components.name: Drive units
components.purpose: The powered and idle ends of a motorised belt system.

components.name: Holders
components.purpose: Supports the track along its run.

components.name: Joints
components.purpose: Joins two lengths of track for a span longer than one stock length.

components.name: Master carriers
components.purpose: The lead runner the motor pulls, carrying the leading edge of the curtain.

components.name: Motors
components.purpose: Drives a motorised track. Sized to the length and weight of the run.

components.name: Runners
components.purpose: The gliders the curtain hooks onto. Roughly 10 per metre of track.

components.name: Stoppers
components.purpose: Caps each end so the runners cannot slide off. Two per track.

components.name: Tracks
components.purpose: The rail itself, cut to your window width.
